flawless: Your creatures never laid a talon on me. They never do.
Order, discipline and clear skies. You brought none of the three.
Back to your training, recruit. The Order expects better of its rivals.
solid: You found a way through my guard with spells. Clever. Not clever enough.
My feathers are ruffled, I admit. My command is not.
close: By the Ancestor, you nearly grounded me. That was fine work.
